reasoning_content:
The problem is a stale libproj-dev 8.2.1 mixed with libproj25 9.3.1. I should upgrade libproj-dev to 9.3.1. Also the GDAL python module (3.6.2 built against system headers which are now 3.8.4, actually it reports 3.8.4) - wait gdal.__version__ 3.8.4 means it's actually reporting runtime? Hmm. It says the python GDAL was compiled against 3.6.2 pyproject spec but the build happened after PPA upgrade... Actually it just installed successfully. The __version__ = 3.8.4 reflects header version at build time (we built after upgrading to 3.8.4). Good, so python GDAL matches runtime lib.

But the segfault is in libproj at exit. It's a known issue with mixed proj. Let me upgrade libproj-dev.

action.command: cd /workspace && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y libproj-dev 2>&1 | tail -6; echo "EXIT:${PIPESTATUS[0]}"; dpkg -l | grep -i "libproj"; echo "==="; poetry run python -c "from osgeo import gdal; print('ok', gdal.__version__)"; echo "EXIT2:$?"
